title: त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Shaunaka asks why Janamejaya held the snake sacrifice. The bard begins the story of Astika: the ascetic Jaratkaru finds his ancestors hanging head down in a pit for want of descendants, agrees to marry a bride of his own name, and Vasuki gives him his sister, who bears Astika.
summary.kn: ಜನಮೇಜಯನು ಸರ್ಪಯಾಗ ಏಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದನೆಂದು ಶೌನಕರು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸೂತನು ಆಸ್ತೀಕನ ಕಥೆ ಆರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ: ಸಂತಾನವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಗುಂಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಲೆಕೆಳಗಾಗಿ ತೂಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಪಿತೃಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡ ಜರತ್ಕಾರು ತನ್ನದೇ ಹೆಸರಿನ ಕನ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಲು ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತಾನೆ; ವಾಸುಕಿ ತನ್ನ ತಂಗಿಯನ್ನು ಕೊಡುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅವಳು ಆಸ್ತೀಕನನ್ನು ಹೆರುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: शौनक पूछते हैं कि जनमेजय ने सर्पयज्ञ क्यों किया। सूत आस्तीक की कथा आरम्भ करते हैं: तपस्वी जरत्कारु सन्तान के अभाव में गड्ढे में उलटे लटके पितरों को देखकर अपने ही नाम की कन्या से विवाह करना स्वीकार करते हैं; वासुकि अपनी बहन देते हैं, जो आस्तीक को जन्म देती है।
summary.te: జనమేజయుడు సర్పయాగం ఎందుకు చేశాడని శౌనకుడు అడుగుతాడు. సూతుడు ఆస్తీకుని కథ ప్రారంభిస్తాడు: సంతానం లేక గుంటలో తలక్రిందులుగా వేలాడుతున్న పితరులను చూసిన జరత్కారుడు తన పేరుగల కన్యను పెళ్లాడడానికి అంగీకరిస్తాడు; వాసుకి తన చెల్లెలిని ఇస్తాడు, ఆమె ఆస్తీకుని కంటుంది.
summary.ta: ஜனமேஜயன் ஸர்ப்ப யாகம் ஏன் செய்தான் என்று ஶௌனகர் கேட்கிறார். ஸூதர் ஆஸ்தீகரின் கதையைத் தொடங்குகிறார்: சந்ததியின்றிக் குழியில் தலைகீழாகத் தொங்கும் முன்னோர்களைக் கண்ட ஜரத்காரு தன் பெயருடைய கன்னியை மணக்க ஒப்புகிறார்; வாஸுகி தன் தங்கையைக் கொடுக்கிறான், அவள் ஆஸ்தீகரைப் பெறுகிறாள்.
summary.ml: ജനമേജയൻ സർപ്പയജ്ഞം നടത്തിയത് എന്തുകൊണ്ടെന്ന് ശൗനകൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. ആസ്തികന്റെ കഥ ഗായകൻ ചൊല്ലിത്തുടങ്ങുന്നു: തപസ്വിയായ ജരത്കാരു തന്റെ പൂർവികർ സന്താനമില്ലാത്തതിനാൽ കുഴിയിൽ തലകീഴായി തൂങ്ങിക്കിടക്കുന്നത് കാണുന്നു. സ്വന്തം പേരുള്ള വധുവിനെ വിവാഹം കഴിക്കാമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം സമ്മതിക്കുന്നു; വാസുകി തന്റെ സഹോദരിയെ നൽകുന്നു, അവളിൽ ആസ്തികൻ ജനിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.13; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: शौनक उवाच

meaning.en: Shaunaka said:

verses.text:
किमर्थं राजशार्दूलः स राजा जनमेजयः ।
सर्पसत्रेण सर्पाणां गतोऽन्तं तद्वदस्व मे ॥

meaning.en: Why did that tiger among kings, King Janamejaya, bring the serpents to their end by the snake sacrifice? Tell me.

verses.text:
आस्तीकश्च द्विजश्रेष्ठः किमर्थं जपतां वरः ।
मोक्षयामास भुजगान्दीप्तात्तस्माद्धुताशनात् ॥

meaning.en: And why did Astika, best of brahmins and of those who recite prayers, free the serpents from that blazing fire?

verses.text:
कस्य पुत्रः स राजासीत्सर्पसत्रं य आहरत् ।
स च द्विजातिप्रवरः कस्य पुत्रो वदस्व मे ॥

meaning.en: Whose son was the king who performed the snake sacrifice? And whose son was that best of the twice-born? Tell me.

verses.text: सूत उवाच

meaning.en: The Suta said:

verses.text:
महदाख्यानमास्तीकं यत्रैतत्प्रोच्यते द्विज ।
सर्वमेतदशेषेण शृणु मे वदतां वर ॥

meaning.en: The story of Astika is a great one, in which all this is told, brahmin. Listen to all of it, best of speakers.

verses.text: शौनक उवाच

meaning.en: Shaunaka said:

verses.text:
श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यशेषेण कथामेतां मनोरमाम् ।
आस्तीकस्य पुराणस्य ब्राह्मणस्य यशस्विनः ॥

meaning.en: I wish to hear this delightful story of the ancient brahmin Astika in full.

verses.text: सूत उवाच

meaning.en: The Suta said:

verses.text:
इतिहासमिमं वृद्धाः पुराणं परिचक्षते ।
कृष्णद्वैपायनप्रोक्तं नैमिषारण्यवासिनः ॥

meaning.en: The elders call this old history, told by Krishna Dvaipayana, the one recited by the dwellers in Naimisha forest.

verses.text:
पूर्वं प्रचोदितः सूतः पिता मे लोमहर्षणः ।
शिष्यो व्यासस्य मेधावी ब्राह्मणैरिदमुक्तवान् ॥

meaning.en: Once, when urged by brahmins, my father Lomaharshana, the wise pupil of Vyasa, told it.

verses.text:
तस्मादहमुपश्रुत्य प्रवक्ष्यामि यथातथम् ।
इदमास्तीकमाख्यानं तुभ्यं शौनक पृच्छते ॥

meaning.en: From him I heard it, and I shall tell it exactly as it is, Shaunaka, to you who ask: this story of Astika.

verses.text:
आस्तीकस्य पिता ह्यासीत्प्रजापतिसमः प्रभुः ।
ब्रह्मचारी यताहारस्तपस्युग्रे रतः सदा ॥

meaning.en: Astika's father was a lord like Prajapati, a celibate, restrained in diet and always devoted to severe austerity.

verses.text:
जरत्कारुरिति ख्यात ऊर्ध्वरेता महानृषिः ।
यायावराणां धर्मज्ञः प्रवरः संशितव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: He was known as Jaratkaru, a great sage of retained seed, foremost among the wandering Yayavaras, who knew dharma and was firm in his vows.

verses.text:
अटमानः कदाचित्स स्वान्ददर्श पितामहान् ।
लम्बमानान्महागर्ते पादैरूर्ध्वैरधोमुखान् ॥

meaning.en: Wandering once, he saw his own forefathers hanging in a great pit, feet up and heads down.

verses.text:
तानब्रवीत्स दृष्ट्वैव जरत्कारुः पितामहान् ।
के भवन्तोऽवलम्बन्ते गर्तेऽस्मिन्वा अधोमुखाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them, Jaratkaru said to the forefathers, "Who are you who hang head-down in this pit?"

verses.text:
वीरणस्तम्बके लग्नाः सर्वतः परिभक्षिते ।
मूषकेन निगूढेन गर्तेऽस्मिन्नित्यवासिना ॥

meaning.en: "You cling to a stalk of virana grass that is being gnawed on every side by a hidden mouse living always in this pit."

verses.text: पितर ऊचुः

meaning.en: The forefathers said:

verses.text:
यायावरा नाम वयमृषयः संशितव्रताः ।
संतानप्रक्षयाद्ब्रह्मन्नधो गच्छाम मेदिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: We are the sages called Yayavaras, of firm vows. Brahmin, because our line is dying out, we are going down to the earth below.

verses.text:
अस्माकं संततिस्त्वेको जरत्कारुरिति श्रुतः ।
मन्दभाग्योऽल्पभाग्यानां तप एव समास्थितः ॥

meaning.en: We have one descendant, known as Jaratkaru, unlucky among the unlucky, who has taken up only austerity.

verses.text:
न स पुत्राञ्जनयितुं दारान्मूढश्चिकीर्षति ।
तेन लम्बामहे गर्ते संतानप्रक्षयादिह ॥

meaning.en: In his folly he does not want to marry and father sons. So we hang in this pit here, because our line is ending.

verses.text:
अनाथास्तेन नाथेन यथा दुष्कृतिनस्तथा ।
कस्त्वं बन्धुरिवास्माकमनुशोचसि सत्तम ॥

meaning.en: We are like helpless sinners, though we have a protector. Who are you, good sir, who grieve for us like a kinsman?

verses.text:
ज्ञातुमिच्छामहे ब्रह्मन्को भवानिह धिष्ठितः ।
किमर्थं चैव नः शोच्याननुकम्पितुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, we wish to know who you are, standing here, and why you should have compassion on us who deserve pity.

verses.text: जरत्कारुरुवाच

meaning.en: Jaratkaru said:

verses.text:
मम पूर्वे भवन्तो वै पितरः सपितामहाः ।
ब्रूत किं करवाण्यद्य जरत्कारुरहं स्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: You are my forefathers and their fathers. Tell me what I can do today; I myself am Jaratkaru.

verses.text: पितर ऊचुः

meaning.en: The forefathers said:

verses.text:
यतस्व यत्नवांस्तात संतानाय कुलस्य नः ।
आत्मनोऽर्थेऽस्मदर्थे च धर्म इत्येव चाभिभो ॥

meaning.en: Child, strive with effort for the continuation of our family. For your own sake and ours, this alone is dharma, mighty one.

verses.text:
न हि धर्मफलैस्तात न तपोभिः सुसंचितैः ।
तां गतिं प्राप्नुवन्तीह पुत्रिणो यां व्रजन्ति ह ॥

meaning.en: Dear son, men with sons reach, not by the fruits of dharma or by well-stored austerities, the goal they reach.

verses.text:
तद्दारग्रहणे यत्नं संतत्यां च मनः कुरु ।
पुत्रकास्मन्नियोगात्त्वमेतन्नः परमं हितम् ॥

meaning.en: So make an effort to take a wife and set your mind on offspring. At our command, child, this is our highest good.

verses.text: जरत्कारुरुवाच

meaning.en: Jaratkaru said:

verses.text:
न दारान्वै करिष्यामि सदा मे भावितं मनः ।
भवतां तु हितार्थाय करिष्ये दारसंग्रहम् ॥

meaning.en: I will not marry; my mind has always been set that way. But for your good I will take a wife.

verses.text:
समयेन च कर्ताहमनेन विधिपूर्वकम् ।
तथा यद्युपलप्स्यामि करिष्ये नान्यथा त्वहम् ॥

meaning.en: I will do so on one condition, in the proper way. If I find it so I will do it, otherwise I will not.

verses.text:
सनाम्नी या भवित्री मे दित्सिता चैव बन्धुभिः ।
भैक्षवत्तामहं कन्यामुपयंस्ये विधानतः ॥

meaning.en: The bride must have the same name as mine and be willingly offered by her kin. I will take such a girl, as if receiving alms, by the rule.

verses.text:
दरिद्राय हि मे भार्यां को दास्यति विशेषतः ।
प्रतिग्रहीष्ये भिक्षां तु यदि कश्चित्प्रदास्यति ॥

meaning.en: For who will give a wife to a poor man like me? But I will accept her as alms if anyone gives her.

verses.text:
एवं दारक्रियाहेतोः प्रयतिष्ये पितामहाः ।
अनेन विधिना शश्वन्न करिष्येऽहमन्यथा ॥

meaning.en: In this way, forefathers, I will try to marry. Otherwise, by this rule alone, I will never do it.

verses.text:
तत्र चोत्पत्स्यते जन्तुर्भवतां तारणाय वै ।
शाश्वतं स्थानमासाद्य मोदन्तां पितरो मम ॥

meaning.en: And from her a being will be born to deliver you; may my forefathers rejoice, having reached an eternal place.

verses.text: सूत उवाच

meaning.en: The Suta said:

verses.text:
ततो निवेशाय तदा स विप्रः संशितव्रतः ।
महीं चचार दारार्थी न च दारानविन्दत ॥

meaning.en: Then that brahmin of firm vows traveled the earth seeking a wife to settle down, but did not find one.

verses.text:
स कदाचिद्वनं गत्वा विप्रः पितृवचः स्मरन् ।
चुक्रोश कन्याभिक्षार्थी तिस्रो वाचः शनैरिव ॥

meaning.en: Once, remembering his forefathers' words, the brahmin went into a forest and called out three times, softly, as a petitioner for a bride.

verses.text:
तं वासुकिः प्रत्यगृह्णादुद्यम्य भगिनीं तदा ।
न स तां प्रतिजग्राह न सनाम्नीति चिन्तयन् ॥

meaning.en: Then Vasuki came forward and offered his sister. Jaratkaru did not accept her, thinking, "She does not have my name."

verses.text:
सनाम्नीमुद्यतां भार्यां गृह्णीयामिति तस्य हि ।
मनो निविष्टमभवज्जरत्कारोर्महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: The mind of the great Jaratkaru was set on taking a wife with the same name who was offered to him.

verses.text:
तमुवाच महाप्राज्ञो जरत्कारुर्महातपाः ।
किंनाम्नी भगिनीयं ते ब्रूहि सत्यं भुजंगम ॥

meaning.en: The very wise and highly ascetic Jaratkaru said to him, "What is your sister's name? Tell me truly, serpent."

verses.text: वासुकिरुवाच

meaning.en: Vasuki said:

verses.text:
जरत्कारो जरत्कारुः स्वसेयमनुजा मम ।
त्वदर्थं रक्षिता पूर्वं प्रतीच्छेमां द्विजोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Jaratkaru, this younger sister of mine is also named Jaratkaru. I kept her for you from the beginning. Accept her, best of brahmins.

verses.text: सूत उवाच

meaning.en: The Suta said:

verses.text:
मात्रा हि भुजगाः शप्ताः पूर्वं ब्रह्मविदां वर ।
जनमेजयस्य वो यज्ञे धक्ष्यत्यनिलसारथिः ॥

meaning.en: Long ago the serpents were cursed by their mother, best of those who know Brahman: "Fire, driven by the wind, will burn you at Janamejaya's sacrifice."

verses.text:
तस्य शापस्य शान्त्यर्थं प्रददौ पन्नगोत्तमः ।
स्वसारमृषये तस्मै सुव्रताय तपस्विने ॥

meaning.en: To end that curse, the best of serpents gave his sister to that sage, an ascetic of good vows.

verses.text:
स च तां प्रतिजग्राह विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ।
आस्तीको नाम पुत्रश्च तस्यां जज्ञे महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: He accepted her by the rite laid down, and by her the great sage had a son named Astika.

verses.text:
तपस्वी च महात्मा च वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः ।
समः सर्वस्य लोकस्य पितृमातृभयापहः ॥

meaning.en: He was an ascetic and great-souled, master of the Vedas and their limbs, impartial to the whole world, and the remover of his parents' fear.

verses.text:
अथ कालस्य महतः पाण्डवेयो नराधिपः ।
आजहार महायज्ञं सर्पसत्रमिति श्रुतिः ॥

meaning.en: After a long time, the Pandava king, Janamejaya, performed the great sacrifice known as the snake sacrifice.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते सत्रे तु सर्पाणामन्तकाय वै ।
मोचयामास तं शापमास्तीकः सुमहायशाः ॥

meaning.en: When that sacrifice began for the destruction of serpents, Astika, of very great fame, freed them from that curse.

verses.text:
नागांश्च मातुलांश्चैव तथा चान्यान्स बान्धवान् ।
पितॄंश्च तारयामास संतत्या तपसा तथा ।
व्रतैश्च विविधैर्ब्रह्मन्स्वाध्यायैश्चानृणोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: He saved the Nagas, his maternal uncles, and his other kin, and his ancestors, by his offspring, austerity and by various vows; and, brahmin, he became free of debt by his study.

verses.text:
देवांश्च तर्पयामास यज्ञैर्विविधदक्षिणैः ।
ऋषींश्च ब्रह्मचर्येण संतत्या च पितामहान् ॥

meaning.en: He satisfied the gods with sacrifices with many gifts, the sages with celibacy, and his forefathers with offspring.

verses.text:
अपहृत्य गुरुं भारं पितॄणां संशितव्रतः ।
जरत्कारुर्गतः स्वर्गं सहितः स्वैः पितामहैः ॥

meaning.en: Having lifted the heavy burden of his forefathers, Jaratkaru of firm vows went to heaven together with his own forefathers.

verses.text:
आस्तीकं च सुतं प्राप्य धर्मं चानुत्तमं मुनिः ।
जरत्कारुः सुमहता कालेन स्वर्गमीयिवान् ॥

meaning.en: Having gained a son Astika and unsurpassed dharma, the sage Jaratkaru went to heaven after a very long time.

verses.text:
एतदाख्यानमास्तीकं यथावत्कीर्तितं मया ।
प्रब्रूहि भृगुशार्दूल किं भूयः कथ्यतामिति ॥

meaning.en: This story of Astika has been told by me as it was. Tell me, tiger of the Bhrigu line, what more shall be told.
